    "letter_title": null,
    "sender_persons": ["John Doe"],
    "receiver_persons": ["Jane Doe", "Johnny Doe"]
  },
  "content": "Dear Jane and Johnny,

I hope this letter finds you both in good health and spirits. I am writing to inform you about a recent event that I believe will be of great interest to you both.

As you may know, I have been involved in the local community theater for many years now. We have recently decided to put on a production of 'Romeo and Juliet' and I am excited to announce that I have been cast in the role of Romeo.

The play will be performed on the 25th and 26th of this month at the town hall. I would love for you both to come and see the performance. It would mean a great deal to me to have your support and encouragement.

I hope to see you both soon.

Yours sincerely,
John"
}

Dear Jane and Johnny,

I hope this letter finds you both in good health and spirits. I am writing to inform you about a recent event that I believe will be of great interest to you both.

As you may know, I have been involved in the local community theater for many years now. We have recently decided to put on a production of 'Romeo and Juliet' and I am excited to announce that I have been cast in the role of Romeo.

The play will be performed on the 25th and 26th of this month at the town hall. I would love for you both to come and see the performance. It would mean a great deal to me to have your support and encouragement.

I hope to see you both soon.

Yours sincerely,
John
